name: Social Pub Night @ East Rock Brewing
plain_text_description:
Welcome to NewHaven.IO, a local community for anyone working in tech or interested in tech in the Greater New Haven region!

What: Social Pub Night with fellow tech professionals and enjoyers
Where: 285 Nicoll St, New Haven, CT 06511
When: Last Tuesday night of September
This is a casual evening for social activities, so no laptops required.
Come hang out, drink some beers (or other beverages), hang out and meet your fellow nerds!
Parking: East Rock Brewing has a parking lot nearby as well as street parking in the neighborhood.
NOTE: be aware of street signs for parking restrictions and fire hydrants

Please consider reading NewHaven.IO's Code of Conduct before attending.
